notes: MAPS: MS2-affinity purified RNA eluates, small RNA library kit -> IP_or_pulldown for both samples (the non-MS2 3'ETSleuZ control is also a column eluate). Growth phase not set: the study pools/mentions both exponential (OD 0.5) and stationary (OD 1.3) harvests without saying which sample is which. Both samples express an arabinose-induced 3'ETSleuZ construct (native sequence); genotype_class native_overexpression is a judgement.

assay_class.q: The soluble fraction was subjected to affinity chromatography.

inducer_added.q: 0.1% arabinose was added to induce the expression of MS2-3'ETSleuZ/3'ETSleuZ during 10 min.
